description: This file contains functions and data for handling MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensors, including sensor readings, decoding lookup tables, and specific sensor configurations.

methods.name: getMaf
methods.description: Returns the MAF sensor voltage using engine parameters.

methods.name: hasMafSensor
methods.description: Checks if the engine configuration has a MAF sensor.

methods.name: getRealMaf
methods.description: Calculates the kg/hour MAF value from ADC reading.

methods.name: fillTheRest
methods.description: Fills remaining decoding entries with default values for binary search.

methods.name: addMafPoint
methods.description: Adds a MAF point to the decoding table.

methods.name: setBosch0280218037
methods.description: Configures MAF decoding table for Bosch 0280218037 sensor.

methods.name: setBosch0280218004
methods.description: Configures MAF decoding table for Bosch 0280218004 sensor.

methods.name: setDensoTODO
methods.description: Configures MAF decoding table for Denso sensor.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNAMaf
methods.description: Configures MAF decoding table for Mazda Miata NA model.
